capabilities: Import family data from GEDCOM 5.5.1, GEDCOM X, Gramps XML, and CSV
Render interactive family charts and static canvas trees with export to PNG, SVG, PDF, and ODT
Generate 17 genealogy report types and compile them into books with bibliography and name index
Map birth, death, and migration locations with clustering, heat maps, and time animation
Track sources and evidence with fact-level citations, conflict detection, and proof summaries
extras: Full documentation is kept on an external website and wiki rather than in the README; the community listing notes it has not been reviewed by staff, and a BRAT beta channel offers pre-release versions.
problem: Obsidian has no genealogy tools, so family tree visualization, GEDCOM import, and evidence/source tracking must be done in separate applications.

relations.evidence: Calendarium integration, Style Settings support, context menu actions
Compatible with Obsidian Bases and Advanced Canvas

summary: Genealogy plugin that imports GEDCOM, GEDCOM X, and Gramps data and renders family tree charts, canvas trees, maps, reports, and source citations inside the vault.
